book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The passengers got off, Passepartout with them.
And in front of the train, a man with a red flag.

sentences.ar: وأشر لجسر بعيد، فوق وادي عميق.
sentences.en: And pointed to a bridge far off, over a deep valley.

sentences.ar: جسر خشب، قديم، ومكسور من جهة.
sentences.en: A wooden bridge, old, broken on one side.
And said: it cannot bear a train.
And we have telegraphed the next station.

sentences.ar: والقطار من هناك بيجي بعد ست ساعات.
sentences.en: And the train from there comes in six hours.
And you walk to the bridge, cross it on foot, and board.

sentences.ar: وفيكس قال: ست ساعات، بنلحق نيويورك.
sentences.en: And Fix said: six hours, we still make New York.

sentences.ar: وبروكتور، اللي فاق، قال بصوت عالي: يا جبنا!
sentences.en: And Proctor, who had woken, said loudly: cowards!

sentences.ar: القطار بيطير فوقه قبل ما يوقع!
sentences.en: The train flies over before it falls!

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو قال: بس... بس نمشي مشي، وبعدين القطار يمرق فاضي!
sentences.en: And Passepartout said: but... but we walk across, and then the train crosses empty!
And they said: a hundred miles an hour!
And backed the train a mile.
And Passepartout sat, and closed his eyes.
The cars shaking, the windows whistling.
The bridge fell into the valley.
And Proctor shouted: I told you!
